To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a graph based parser with second order mean field edge inference and an extended pointer generator node generator can achieve state-of-the-art results on cross framework meaning representation parsing.

(1) a graph based parser that uses an extended pointer generator to generate nodes and a second-order mean field variational model to predict edges achieves competitive performance on the CoNLL-19 Cross Framework Meaning Representation parsing task; (2) the use of a second order mean-field model to predict edges improves the performance of the graph based parser.

(1) A second order mean field inference module can be applied to meaning representation parsing to improve the performance of the system; (2) A pointer generator network can be extended to generate nodes as well as edges; (3) The proposed system is competitive on the in and cross framework ranks.
